Payout-mode flag selects the ETH unwrap branch inside removeLiquidity.
Deposit data is consumed exclusively to build the relay in relayDeposit.
Realized LP fee percentage is stored into the relay record created by relayDeposit.
Relay data only exists to validate and pay the instant relay in speedUpRelay.
Deposit data only identifies the relay being sped up in speedUpRelay.
Relay data is only used to compute hashes and dispute the relay in disputeRelay.
Relay data is only consumed for validation and payout computation in settleRelay.
New admin address is only assigned inside the admin-gated changeAdmin.
Rate value is only stored by the admin-gated setLpFeeRatePerSecond.
Flag is only assigned to the relaysEnabled state in setRelaysEnabled.
Deposit data is only used to create and instantly pay a relay in relayAndSpeedUp.
